scope: Fixed authored corpus and actual original-controller receipts; no query/answer/oracle content. Whole-response success with a tool receipt is not per-tool causal attribution or proof of foreign physical execution.
capability_matrix_scope: Required alternatives are annotations, not a demand to execute every equivalent. Prohibitions differ from blocked intended tasks. Module-local controlled-clock/process handlers are original semantics over controlled observations, not real host facts. Untested/policy-ineligible capabilities stay explicit.

required_execution_coverage_or_dispositi.limitation: successful ToolResult/authority disposition does not alone prove complete task or grounded response

semantic_argument_annotations.scope: Annotated fields only; raw generated arguments and original admitted/defaulted fields have distinct denominators. No blanket semantic validity claim for unannotated arguments.

full_grounded_response_accuracy.scope: All actual controller responses independently reviewed; correct partial grounding does not imply complete task. Controlled source failures retained.

full_response_review.review_method: Independent verifier read complete controller text, owner request and original recorded returned sources; individual failure/qualification notes below. Batches are reviewed, not inferred from automatic metrics.
